protocol.boundary: per-pair BIC plateau evidence at both hold 10 and hold 30 after five midpoint bisections
protocol.effect_curve: difference of post-H=8 displacement in internally normalised anonymous pose/velocity families
protocol.amplification: BIC comparison of constant/decay against the same model plus sustained nonnegative quadratic growth
protocol.persistence: BIC comparison of late decay-to-zero against a nonzero asymptote
protocol.decision: the same >=2/3 refined pairs pass boundary, amplification and persistence
protocol.task_information: none in alarm; Jenga classes are grading only
